test_cases.name: Clickable Div Button Lacking Keyboard Support and Role
test_cases.rationale: Clickable non-interactive div lacks keyboard focus, keyboard event listeners, and button role.

test_cases.name: Icon-Only Button Lacking Programmatic Accessible Name
test_cases.rationale: Button containing only an SVG icon provides no text label or aria-label for screen readers.

test_cases.name: Custom Tabs Lacking Arrow Key Navigation and State
test_cases.rationale: Custom tab controls omit arrow navigation keys and aria-selected state.

test_cases.name: Focus Indicator Removed Completely via Inline CSS
test_cases.rationale: Disabling outline without replacement focus styling destroys keyboard visibility (WCAG 2.4.7).

test_cases.name: Expandable Accordion Fails to Sync aria-expanded
test_cases.rationale: Accordion toggle button omits aria-expanded and aria-controls attributes.

test_cases.name: Form Validation Error Not Programmatically Linked
test_cases.rationale: Validation error text is rendered without aria-invalid or aria-describedby linkage.

test_cases.name: System Status Conveyed Exclusively by Color
test_cases.rationale: Colored status dot has no accompanying visible text or accessible label (WCAG 1.4.1).

test_cases.name: Informative Chart Image Missing alt Attribute
test_cases.rationale: Informative revenue chart image lacks alt description, leaving screen readers unaware of content.

test_cases.name: Dynamic Status Toast Lacking aria-live Region
test_cases.rationale: Asynchronous success toast message is not announced to assistive technology users.

test_cases.name: Infinite Animation Lacking Reduced-Motion Preference
test_cases.rationale: Pulsing animation runs continuously without prefers-reduced-motion media query override.

test_cases.name: Clean Baseline - Fully Accessible Semantic Modal with ARIA Roles
test_cases.rationale: Modal includes aria-modal, aria-labelledby, labeled close button, and hidden decorative SVGs.
